records.name: Low-Amplitude Forward Jump to Stick

exactMechanics.start: Declared bilateral stance on the floor; one low-amplitude horizontal jump from two feet. Declare distance and a visible target appropriate to the actual athlete and protected station.
exactMechanics.arms: The inspected exact contract does not fix an arm position or swing. The session must declare a repeatable arm rule as an authored contextual choice; do not claim a particular hands-on-hips or free-swing style was mandated by source220.
exactMechanics.landing: One bilateral two-foot landing inside the declared target; absorb through ankles, knees and hips with controlled knee/trunk organization and quiet contact.
exactMechanics.hold: Terminal athletic stick for the declared duration; source legacy tempo and related research packet use two seconds. No extra step, rebound or second takeoff during the task.
exactMechanics.reset: After the owned terminal hold, fully reset before another attempt. A walked return belongs outside the held landing and needs its own stated route, duration and recovery accounting.
exclusions: travel to recover balance before completing the hold
exactMechanics.attemptAccounting: One attempted jump has one intentional flight/landing event and two individual landing-foot contacts when both feet land. Source landingContactsPerRep=2 uses feet, not two jumps. Count actual attempts/contacts, including invalid attempts; valid repetitions are a separate result.

prerequisites: Pain-free low bilateral jump and landing at the assigned demand.
Previously owned quiet bilateral Drop Squat/Snap-Down terminal position; no automatic qualification from attending OR-01 or performing a slow squat.
Understands two-foot takeoff/landing, target, hold, stop signal and reset.
Safe clear station; exact lower-body impact, technical fatigue, supervision and time budgets fit.

candidateDeliveryProfile.intensity: declared low amplitude; no distance chasing

legacyDefaults.tempo: bilateral takeoff; low forward travel; quiet bilateral landing; two-second stick; reset

sourceDoseNotSessionPrescription.boundary: These distinct source estimates are not one coherent finished lesson clock. Any lower instructional dose, between-attempt recovery placement or added demonstration/rehearsal is an explicit OR-02 prescription decision. Do not repeat invalid attempts until a success quota is met.

sourceClearance.surface: clean, dry, level, stable non-slip floor
sourceClearance.space: marked standing/landing station with clear forward and lateral landing space and protected entry/exit
inspection: coach sightline to takeoff, landing, knees, trunk, hold and reset

stopRules: Stop for pain, giving way, slip, unsafe station or athlete request.
Stop for asymmetry, loud/stiff landing, knee/trunk collapse, extra step, missed target, rebound or inability to hold; record invalid attempt and actual exposure.
If quality cannot be restored at the reduced assigned demand and recovery, omit flight and use a separately specified eligible task; symptoms are not permission to exercise through a fallback.
alternativeEligibility: SNAP-STICK changes the job to grounded rapid position acquisition and records no jump competence or jump event.
Reducing jump distance retains this identity only if the bilateral takeoff/landing and held finish remain intact and the exact change is revalidated.
An in-place vertical jump, unilateral hop, hurdle jump or rebound is not a silent equivalent.

Confirm task-specific prerequisite; instructional participation does not waive the source jump prerequisite or prove mastery.

records.name: Snap-Down to Stick
records.legacySourceExplanation: Migration354 archives source139/541/1105 baseline keys; migration726 moves source217 Drop Squat provenance onto the snap-down survivor. These are historical source references, not four selectable approved alternatives.

exactMechanics.start: Stand tall in a declared repeatable bilateral stance on the floor, arms overhead or at an explicitly declared reachable position, with comfortable overhead clearance.
exactMechanics.arms: Rapidly drive the arms down while lowering the center of mass. Hands-at-chest is locally described as an arm-start/access modifier; if chosen, specify what the hands actually do and retain controlled rapid descent. It is not a newly approved named variant.
exactMechanics.takeoff: None. Apply migration727's stronger explicit boundary: no preparatory jump, takeoff, flight or rebound. Do not exploit older flight:not_required wording to insert a hop.
exactMechanics.finish: Rapid but controlled descent into a declared comfortable athletic depth; both feet grounded with whole-foot pressure, knees aligned with feet, trunk organized over pelvis.
exactMechanics.hold: Own a static two-second finish. Variant range is two to three seconds, both cited delivery profiles target two seconds. No extra step or rebound.
exactMechanics.reset: Stand tall and breathe before the next repetition; begin only after a full reset. A safe exit follows the owned stick.
exclusions: external support disguised as the same exact variant
exactMechanics.attemptAccounting: No intentional flight/landing event and source landingContactsPerRep=0; count actual grounded descent/stick attempts separately.

prerequisites: Pain-free bodyweight squat to the declared depth.
Safe controlled rapid descent and ability to hold the bilateral athletic stance without an extra step.
Understands stop signal; coach can observe feet, knees, trunk and finish.
Appropriate dry floor, clearance, supervision and actual task-specific confidence.

sourceDoseNotSessionPrescription.boundary: Source quality-limited candidate ranges are not mandatory OR-02 volume. A lower teaching dose or slower rehearsal must be labeled and clocked. Neither fast snap-down completion nor slow practice qualifies a jump automatically.

sourceClearance.sourceConflict: The definition gives a 1.5m clear radius, while its profile gives a 2x2m footprint. Do not silently select the smaller allocation. A centered 3x3m personal bay accommodates the larger nominal radius, but actual athlete reach, adjacent traffic and coach circulation still need verification.

stopRules: Stop for symptoms, giving way, dizziness, uncontrolled descent, repeated knee/trunk collapse, unstable/noisy finish, extra step, rebound, breath holding, fear, unsafe floor or athlete request.
Reduce speed/depth only within comfortable observed control. If rapid descent is unavailable, record slow position rehearsal as an explicit adaptation rather than a successful rapid snap-down.
Stable hand support changes the task and requires variant review.
alternativeEligibility: Source217 Drop Squat to Stick is consolidated/archived as a duplicate by migration726; do not select its old profile as a separate approved record.
A deliberately slow squat-to-hold lesson can be documented as modified position rehearsal. It does not satisfy rapid-descent or flight competence.
The fallback changes OR-02's jump objective to a partial-purpose grounded task; log jump not observed.

reusedMappings.sourceMechanicsRetained: Soft knees, hands across chest or behind head as declared; hips move back through owned range, trunk organized, stand/reset. Unloaded, no rapid drop or flight.
reusedMappings.or02Boundary: This hip-dominant hinge is distinct from the knee/hip/ankle-flexing snap-down landing shape. Wall-touch, supported hinge and loaded RDL are not hidden equivalents.

reusedMappings.sourceMechanicsRetained: No load or mandatory box; three-count lowering, brief bottom pause in owned depth, controlled stand/reset.
reusedMappings.or02Boundary: The deliberate tempo squat is not the rapid snap-down action and earns no flight qualification.
Retain exact stable support height, body line and contact mechanics from the exemplar; new age/dose choices belong to the session.
Exact bench-supported dumbbell variant uses opposite hand AND knee on the bench. Count both sides and individual bench/load fit; a hand-only row is different.

Fixed vertical arms, tabletop base, one bent-leg heel-contact-and-return before alternating. Tabletop/return readiness must fit. Only Prepare and Access profile verified; Strength placement remains a declared contextual adaptation. State whether session rep means one side or a paired cycle.

methodReuse.boundary: Root owns methods and prescriptions. Jump and snap-down candidates require technical practice/fully reset quality attempts with actual recovery, not a conditioning circuit or automatic make-up successes.
